text:
Overhead view of a white plastic baseplate resting on a white foam sheet, with a dark grey tiled floor visible at the right edge.

Mounted on the plate: two square white blocks at left (upper and lower), each with a raised circular disc on top and four screws at the corners, both closed. At upper right, a similar square block with an open circular through-hole showing a recessed bore, secured by corner screws.

Centrally, an elongated white rectangular module lies lengthwise, its top face bearing two columns of six square copper-coloured pads (twelve total), with small screws at its four corners.

The plate has several empty holes and inset fasteners. A small metal fitting protrudes at the bottom edge. No liquids visible.
